newsitem.title: USA: Ugly Duckling to sell up to 5 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Ugly Duckling to sell up to 5 mln shrs.

text.p: Ugly Duckling Corp said Monday it planned a private sale of up to five million shares of its common stock.
The shares would be sold to institutional investors at a price to be determined, the used car and finance company said.
If all five million shares were sold, the company would have about 18 million shares outstanding, a company spokesman said.

Ugly Duckling said it planned to use the proceeds in its growth strategy, which may include the acquisition or development of car dealerships and finance operations, expansion of its contract portfolio, and the acquisition and development of new products and services.
